lines.zh: 发出低沉吼声，步伐沉重。
向前缓缓行走，低声吼叫。
它守在阿努的祭坛边，一动不动。
lines.en: It stands by Anu's altar without moving.

lines.zh: 它把斧子换到另一只手。
lines.en: It shifts its axe to the other hand.

lines.zh: 它低头嗅了嗅地上的灰。
lines.en: It lowers its snout to the ash.
It counts the braziers in the hall.

lines.zh: 它僵直地站着，像一尊雕像。
lines.en: It stands rigid as a statue.

lines.zh: 它偶尔摸一下腰间的金块。
lines.en: It sometimes touches the gold at its belt.

lines.zh: 视线聚焦玩家，露出獠牙。
目光锁定玩家，嘶吼威胁。
它嗅到你的气味，抬起头。
lines.en: It catches your scent and lifts its head.

lines.zh: 它用一只眼打量着你的护甲。
lines.en: One eye sizes up your armor.
The gold still lies beneath the rotten flesh.
I haven't handed in my gold yet.

lines.zh: 腐肉从伤口掉出来，它低吼。
lines.en: Rotten flesh falls from the wound; it growls.
Anu told me to hold. I hold.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着贪婪的光芒。

lines.en: I smell the stench of rotten meat.

lines.zh: 它盯着我，似乎要吃了我。
lines.en: It stares at me, hungry to eat.

lines.zh: 我的食物不足以诱惑它。
lines.en: My food is not enough to tempt it.

lines.zh: 我靠近腐肉，吸引它的注意。
lines.en: I approach the rotten meat to catch its attention.
Its gaze is fixed on the rotten meat.
I dare not get close to the gold blocks.

lines.zh: 它的体型庞大，难以躲避。
lines.en: Its size makes it hard to avoid.

lines.zh: 我被它的巨大身躯撞倒了。
lines.en: I was knocked down by its large body.
I dodged too late and was knocked away.
Its collision feels like an earthquake.
I was dazed by the impact.

lines.zh: 它的行动缓慢但撞击力大。
lines.en: Its slow movements pack a big punch.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的身躯撞击我。
lines.en: It撞 me with its massive body.
I tried to avoid its collision.
It collided with me but did no damage.
Its voice is full of desire.

lines.zh: 它把金块推到对方面前，等着。
lines.en: It pushes a gold nugget forward and waits.
It longs to find a partner.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声引来了同类。
lines.en: Its mating call draws its kind.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，眼中闪着红光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow red, fixing you with a stare.

lines.zh: 腐肉的香味在空中飘荡。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 它用尖锐的牙齿咬下一块肉。
lines.en: It snarls, teeth bared, biting a chunk of meat.

lines.zh: 金块闪烁着金属的光芒。
它低吼着，准备发起攻击。
它的皮肤上长满了锈迹。
它用蹄子在地上敲出响声。
lines.en: It taps the ground with its hooves.

lines.zh: 猪灵哨兵从洞穴中走出。
lines.en: Sentry Piglins emerge from the cave.

lines.zh: 它将金块紧紧抓在爪中。
lines.en: It clutches the gold in its claws.

lines.zh: 它的眼神变得更为锐利。
它已经发现了你的身影。

lines.en: Its armor glints in the sunlight.
Anu told me to guard this spot.

lines.zh: 它已经瞄准了你的弱点。
阿努抬了抬手，它便转向你。
lines.en: Anu lifts a hand, and it turns to you.

lines.zh: 它从祭坛台阶上缓步下来。
lines.en: It steps slowly down from the altar stairs.

lines.zh: 它把斧刃对准你的胸口。
lines.en: It levels its axe at your chest.

lines.zh: 它低吼一声，把你的位置报给阿努。
lines.en: It growls, reporting your place to Anu.

lines.zh: 它挪动沉重的脚步，朝你走来。
lines.en: Its heavy feet shift toward you.
It marks which way you dodge.

lines.zh: 它把盾侧过来，挡住你的退路。
lines.en: It angles its shield across your retreat.
It begins to flank around the hall.
It points its spear at you.
It aims its axe at you.

lines.zh: 它把斧刃横过来，挡住火光。
lines.en: It turns its axe flat to block the firelight.
It prepares to shoot an arrow.
Its weapon is aimed at you.
It starts to stab with its spear.

lines.zh: 它把长矛尖抵在祭坛石缝里。
lines.en: It braces its spear tip in the altar's crack.

lines.zh: 它瞄准了你的弱点攻击。
它举起斧子，等你靠近半步。
lines.en: It raises its axe, waiting for half a step.
Its breath rasps like a bellows.

lines.zh: 它把铁靴在地上碾出印子。
lines.en: Its iron boot grinds a mark in the floor.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的膝盖，那里好砍。
lines.en: It eyes your knees, an easy cut.

lines.zh: 它一步步压过来，不给空隙。
lines.en: It presses in step by step, leaving no gap.
It sets its body like a wall.

lines.zh: 它把斧子半举着，随时落下。
lines.en: It holds the axe half-raised, ready to fall.

lines.zh: 它和金块一样沉，一样难缠。
lines.en: It is as heavy and stubborn as its gold.

lines.zh: 它等你举盾，好绕到侧面。
lines.en: It waits for your shield, then moves around it.

lines.zh: 它每呼吸一次，就逼近一寸。
lines.en: With each breath it closes an inch.

lines.zh: 冲撞敌人，满地都是肉泥！
用头撞击，敌方头破血流！
斧刃劈在你的盾沿上，火星四溅。
lines.en: The axe bites your shield rim and throws sparks.

lines.zh: 它用肩甲把你顶退两步。
lines.en: Its shoulder plate shoves you back two steps.

lines.zh: 它一斧砍空，砸裂了地砖。
lines.en: A missed swing splits the floor tiles.

lines.zh: 它反手一记，砸向你的肋侧。
lines.en: Its backhand slams into your ribs.

lines.zh: 祭坛的火盆亮了，它跨出一步。
lines.en: The altar brazier flares; it steps out.

lines.zh: 阿努的吼声落下，它跨出火光。
lines.en: Anu roars, and it steps out of the firelight.

lines.zh: 祭坛四周的猪灵队列里，它最沉。
lines.en: Of the piglin ranks at the altar, it is the heaviest.

lines.zh: 它从阿努身后的阴影里现身。
lines.en: It appears from the shadow behind Anu.

lines.zh: 金块被放开，它站了起来。
lines.en: The gold is set down, and it stands.

lines.zh: 它的盔甲还沾着上一位挑战者的血。
lines.en: Its armor still carries the last challenger's blood.

lines.zh: 大厅的火盆同时一暗，它来了。
lines.en: The hall braziers dim together, and it arrives.

lines.zh: 它踩上祭坛的第一级台阶。
lines.en: It mounts the first step of the altar.

lines.zh: 阿努的召唤声在石壁间回响，它应了。
lines.en: Anu's call rings off the stone, and it answers.

lines.zh: 它从封印的裂隙里挤出来。
lines.en: It squeezes out of the seal's fissure.

lines.zh: 它低着头，慢慢走进火光里。
lines.en: Head low, it walks slowly into the light.

lines.zh: 金块被炸飞，它扑过去捡。
lines.en: The blast flings its gold; it lunges to retrieve it.
Screams in pain from the void
